\documentclass{article}
\newcommand{\named}[1]{\textbf{#1}}
\title{Comments and Escapes}
\author{Edge Case}
\begin{document}
\maketitle

% A comment with fake structure: \section{not real}
\section{Escaped text}
Text with \% percent, \& ampersand, \# hash, \_ underscore, \{ braces \}, and ``quotes''.
A macro says \named{bold text}; a URL-like token is \texttt{path/to/a\_file}.

\begin{quote}
A quoted paragraph has a line break
inside the source but remains one visual block.
\end{quote}

\begin{enumerate}
\item First item with an inline command.
\item Second item with a footnote\footnote{The footnote contains commas, braces \{x\}, and a percent \%.}.
\end{enumerate}

\section{Raw commands}
\verb|\section{not parsed}| and \verb*| spaces stay literal |.
\begin{verbatim}
% this is not a comment
\textbf{this is not bold}
\end{verbatim}

\end{document}
